<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918574_theRebbe_925" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918574_theRebbe_925__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Even though the level of "bound in one bond" is lofty, through Rashbi's opening of the channel, every Jew receives the power to study Torah with his soul bound to it, becoming one with Torah and its Giver, especially through the study of Pnimiyus HaTorah, which hastens the redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, even though this is "in one bond I am bound,"</t>
    <t s="2">and certainly this "in which it is grasped"</t>
    <t s="3">is a most exalted level,</t>
    <t s="4">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="5">through the fact that Rashbi opened and said "in one bond I am bound," etc.,</t>
    <t s="6">for the explanation of "opened" is62</t>
    <t s="7">that he opened the channel,</t>
    <t s="8">power was given to every single Jew that there should be for him an iota and a trace63</t>
    <t s="9">of this matter,</t>
    <t s="10">that his study of Torah should be in a manner that his soul is bound to the Torah in all his inwardness,</t>
    <t s="11">for although there are times when he is forced to interrupt his study of Torah,64</t>
    <t s="12">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="13">at the time of study it should be</t>
    <t s="14">(the study of Torah)</t>
    <t s="15">his entire existence,</t>
    <t s="16">to the point that he is one with the Torah and with the Giver of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="17">literally one.65</t>
    <t s="18">And the granting of power for this with greater intensity is through the study of the inner dimension of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="19">the Torah of Rashbi,66</t>
    <t s="20">for through this there is the power</t>
    <t s="21">(even more so)</t>
    <t s="22">to connect and unite with the Torah and the Giver of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="23">And through the study and dissemination of the Torah of Rashbi,</t>
    <t s="24">which in these generations has been revealed in the teachings of Chassidus,</t>
    <t s="25">we also bring closer the redemption,</t>
    <t s="26">as per the promise of the King Moshiach to the Baal Shem Tov67</t>
    <t s="27">that "when your wellsprings spread forth outward, I will come, this is the King Moshiach,"</t>
    <t s="28">and as it is stated in the Zohar68</t>
    <t s="29">that "in this composition of yours"</t>
    <t s="30">(of Rashbi)</t>
    <t s="31">etc. "they will go out from exile with mercy."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
